name: Takamine Takashi
source:
The protagonist of the "Lost Foreign Legion" scenario. A member of the French Foreign Legion. 25 years old. After being bullied as a child, he learned various martial arts. As he grew up, he began to question his life, and left Japan three years ago to join the French Foreign Legion. However, after spending all his time in rigorous training and fighting, he realized that he had a sadistic side that loved violence, such as killing babies and prostitutes, and effectively deserted the Legion and returned to Japan.
In combat, he is good at fighting opponents that wield knives, and is proud of his special technique where he holds down the enemy's dominant wrist and slices the opponent's throat with the tip of their blade.
His hobbies are reading. His special skill is playing the tenor saxophone. He is a Libra.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/街_〜運命の交差点〜]Wikipedia[/url]]
